ruleDefinitions.name: MacOS Network Service Scanning
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local or remote network services.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/nc$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netcat$")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*l.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/nmap$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/telnet$"))
